title: Python Developer | Remote
description:
**Python Developers, Backend Engineers & Open-Source Software Engineers. Remote AI Project**

We are seeking experienced Python Developers, Software Engineers, Backend Engineers, and Open-Source Contributors to contribute to a remote AI project focused on real-world software engineering, bug fixing, repository analysis, and large language model (LLM) evaluation.

**What You’ll Do**

* Analyze, categorize, and triage GitHub issues across popular open-source libraries and frameworks.
* Investigate software bugs, feature requests, regressions, and implementation challenges.
* Set up and configure existing repositories for reproducible local execution.
* Create and maintain Dockerized development and testing environments.
* Evaluate unit test coverage, test quality, and the reliability of existing test suites.
* Modify, execute, and debug Python codebases locally.
* Assess LLM-generated bug fixes for correctness, completeness, and maintainability.
* Identify hidden bugs, unhandled edge cases, and incomplete implementations.
* Validate whether proposed solutions resolve the original issue without introducing regressions.
* Collaborate with researchers to identify challenging repositories and GitHub issues for AI evaluation.
* Document repository configurations, reproduction steps, technical findings, and validation results.

**Who Can Apply**

**Relevant backgrounds include Python Developers, Senior Python Developers, Python Software Engineers, Software Engineers, and Software Developers.**

**We also welcome Backend Engineers, Backend Developers, Python Backend Developers, API Developers, and Full-Stack Engineers with strong Python experience.**

**Open-source backgrounds may include Open-Source Developers, Open-Source Contributors, Repository Maintainers, and Developer Tools Engineers.**

**Infrastructure backgrounds may include DevOps Engineers, Platform Engineers, Infrastructure Engineers, Build Engineers, and Site Reliability Engineers with substantial hands-on Python development experience.**

**Testing backgrounds may include Software Development Engineers in Test (SDETs), Test Automation Engineers, Software QA Engineers, and Python Automation Engineers with strong software engineering skills.**

**Additional relevant backgrounds include Research Software Engineers, ML Engineers, Data Engineers, Systems Engineers, and Technical Leads with experience maintaining and debugging complex Python applications.**

**Requirements**

* Substantial professional experience in software engineering or software development.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python.
* Proficiency with Git and GitHub-based development workflows.
* Strong experience with Docker and containerized development environments.
* Familiarity with basic software pipeline and CI/CD configuration.
* Ability to read, understand, modify, and debug complex software codebases.
* Experience setting up unfamiliar repositories and resolving dependency issues.
* Strong understanding of unit testing, test coverage, and software validation.
* Strong analytical reasoning and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to document technical findings and reproducible workflows clearly.

**Preferred Background**

* Professional experience in Python development, backend engineering, systems development, or open-source software engineering.
* Experience contributing to or maintaining public GitHub repositories.
* Experience with Django, Flask, FastAPI, or other Python frameworks.
* Experience with pytest, unittest, coverage.py, or automated testing frameworks.
* Experience with Docker, Docker Compose, Linux, and Bash scripting.
* Experience with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar CI/CD platforms.
* Experience investigating complex GitHub issues and reviewing pull requests.
* Experience performing root cause analysis, regression testing, or software quality reviews.

This opportunity is ideal for experienced Python engineers who can open a GitHub repository, understand its architecture, configure a reproducible development environment, investigate complex software issues, evaluate test quality, and determine whether an AI-generated code change genuinely resolves the problem without introducing new bugs.
